description:
## Bug Fixes

### YouTube - Built-in downloader
- **Offline library and player icons:** the search, sort, cancel, back, speed, rotate, previous, play, pause and next buttons now use YouTube-style outline icons instead of the Android system icons.
- **Seekbar:** the offline player's seekbar is a thin bar in YouTube's red and follows `Custom seekbar color` when it is on.
- **Check marks:** the sort menu and the playback speed menu show a check mark on the right of the selected row instead of radio buttons.
- **Title alignment:** the "Downloads" title is centered with the back arrow, like the RVX settings toolbar.

### YouTube - Visual preferences icons
- **Icon style: Bold** now also makes the RVX entry in the YouTube settings bold (it stayed thin before). The letter icons that are already bold and the colored ReVanced logo are not changed.

## Notes
- Notification icons of the offline player are unchanged.

## Compatibility
- YouTube: **21.39.525, 21.13.164, 20.05.46**.
- YouTube Music: **9.40.51, 9.15.51, 8.30.54**.

[Full changelog](https://github.com/lavinhoque33/revanced-patches/compare/v1.10.0...v1.10.1)
